target: game.dll tick rate — 500ms to 16ms (60hz position updates)

patches.name: tickrate_500ms_to_16ms
patches.description: Changes position update interval from 500ms (2/sec) to 16ms (~60/sec). Instruction at VA 0x4481EA: mov dword_5992E0, 1F4h → mov dword_5992E0, 10h. The 4-byte LE value is at file offset 0x481F0.
patches.note: Server speedhack detector (Arena.cs PlayerMove) must be adjusted — 500 states in <30s triggers kick. At 60hz, 500 states = 8.3s. Raise threshold or adjust time window.
